authorizePoster(address,string).details: Rules: only the admin; not address(0); the admin can never be a poster (separation of duties);      not already a poster; label 1–32 bytes.

params.label: Role label shown in the UI, e.g. "Treasurer".

constructor.details: Rule: exactly one admin, fixed at deployment (there is no admin transfer).

correctEntry(uint256,uint256,string,stri.details: Rules: (1) only CURRENT posters (a revoked poster cannot correct); (2) the entry must exist;      (3) only the latest version can be corrected — no forks, no edits;      (4) reason 1–140 bytes, same text caps as postEntry; (5) newAmount may be 0 (= cancel) or restore      a cancelled entry; (6) the correction can never push the balance below zero (checked before subtracting).      The receipt number and kind are inherited; idByRef keeps pointing at the original.

returns.newId: The id of the new (latest) version.

entryCount().details: Rule: ids run 1..entryCount() with no gaps; entries are never removed.

getEntries(uint256,uint256).details: Rules: count is capped at 50; startId == 0 or startId > entryCount() returns an empty array;      the end is clamped to entryCount().

getEntry(uint256).details: Rule: reverts "Entry does not exist" when id is 0 or beyond entryCount().

postEntry(uint8,uint256,string,string,st.details: Rules, checked in this order: (1) only authorised posters; (2) amount > 0;      (3) receipt number is 1–16 bytes of A–Z, 0–9, '-'; (4) a receipt number can only be recorded once;      (5) category 1–32 bytes, counterparty ≤ 64, description ≤ 280;      (6) an expense can never exceed the recorded balance (the books never go negative).

revokePoster(address).details: Rules: only the admin; the wallet must currently be a poster.

summary().details: Rule: balance always equals totalIncome - totalExpense.

versionsOf(string).details: Rule: starts at idByRef (the original) and follows correctedBy until 0. Unknown receipt → empty.

authorizePoster(address,string).notice: Authorise a wallet to record money (make it a treasurer).

constructor.notice: Creates the ledger. The deployer becomes the admin (Club Advisor).

correctEntry(uint256,uint256,string,stri.notice: Correct an entry by appending a new linked version. The corrected version is never modified.

entryCount().notice: Number of entries (originals + corrections) ever recorded.

getEntries(uint256,uint256).notice: Read a page of entries starting at startId.

postEntry(uint8,uint256,string,string,st.notice: Record a new income or expense entry.

revokePoster(address).notice: Remove a treasurer's right to record or correct money. Their label is kept for history.

summary().notice: One-call overview for the home page.

versionsOf(string).notice: Every version id for a receipt number, original first, latest last.
